Signature move

The Euro step.

He picks the ball up high on the drive, takes one long stride to one side so the help defender commits, then steps back across and finishes around him, often with a soft floater. As Monty Williams put it when he coached the Pistons: he “euro-steps around the help.”

  1. The gather. Picks the ball up high with both hands, still at full speed.
  2. Step one. One long stride to one side. The help defender slides over.
  3. Step two. A second long stride back across, around him, and a soft floater.
